comment: GENERATED by tests/test_ownir_validation_fixtures.py --write; do not edit. Python (ownlang.ownir.load) is authoritative. The BR-D1 strict-door acceptance language for P-022 step 6b, #259 checkpoint 1. Compared across languages: accepted/rejected and, on rejection, the CATEGORY -- never the message text, which is a human-facing presentation aid in the reference.

categories.json: the document is not JSON at all
categories.shape: right place, but the value has no representable primitive or container form the contract requires
categories.vocabulary: right JSON type, value outside a closed set
categories.identity: a name slot — empty, mistyped, or duplicated
categories.location: a REPRESENTABLE source coordinate violating its coordinate-domain rule — currently the 1-based column
categories.well_formedness: right types, legal vocabulary, and the record still cannot mean anything
